title: RootBackupDeclarationProduction
description: A custodian's public declaration of how their single BANZA root private key is backed up under the 2-of-3 custody model. Declarative and public: it asserts that the backup is encrypted, that the passphrase is stored off-device (separately from the encrypted backup), that the backup medium is a USB device, and that NO plaintext private key exists. This declaration carries NO secret content — no private key, no seed, no passphrase value ever appears; only the boolean assertions do. A declaration with plaintext_private_key:true, or missing encrypted backup, is a backup gap and yields M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_BACKUP_GAP. Status is computed by applying the rules stated in this contract. The rules are the definition; no implementation of them is.
_authority: Root Trust Ceremony (2-of-3 offline custody, docs/governance PKI trust model)
_boundary: Root trust for the BANZA open financial protocol. The root does NOT authorise payment services, does NOT create operators, does NOT issue licences, does NOT move/settle/hold funds, and does NOT replace operator regulatory authorisation. BANZA remains an open financial protocol; PSPs/banks/authorised operators are separate entities that implement it.

key_id.description: The single root key id this backup protects (e.g. 'root-key-A').

encrypted_backup.description: The backup of the root private key is encrypted. False/absent is a backup gap (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_BACKUP_GAP).

passphrase_stored_off_device.description: The decryption passphrase is stored off-device, separately from the encrypted backup. The passphrase VALUE never appears in any artifact.

backup_medium.description: Offline backup medium. A USB device kept in secure custody.

plaintext_private_key.description: No plaintext private key exists anywhere. True is FORBIDDEN and makes the ceremony INVALID (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_INVALID_FORBIDDEN_PRIVATE_KEY_MATERIAL).
